# X Look

> X Look is a free Chrome (MV3) extension that turns x.com into a quiet, work-friendly reading list: no left nav, no trends column, no Grok or messages drawer, no promoted posts, one calm centred column, and images and videos hidden until you click them.

This site has WebMCP tools. Both pages register them with `document.modelContext.registerTool`, so an agent in the visitor's browser can call them instead of scraping the page. All three are read-only, take no input, and answer in the page's own language.

## Pages that declare WebMCP tools

- [English](https://xlook.cocode.dk/): declares `describe`, `list_features`, `get_install_steps`
- [فارسی (Persian)](https://xlook.cocode.dk/fa/): declares the same three tools, answering in Persian

## Tools

- `describe`: says what the page is; returns `{ language, title, summary, download_url, sections: [{ id, heading }], tools: [string] }`
- `list_features`: lists every change X Look makes to x.com; returns `{ language, features: [{ name, detail }] }`
- `get_install_steps`: the ordered install steps and the download link; returns `{ language, download_url, steps: [string] }`. It installs nothing.

The tools work in Chrome with WebMCP switched on (`chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing`); elsewhere the pages read as plain HTML.

## Links

- [Download x-look.zip](https://github.com/cocodedk/x-look/releases/latest/download/x-look.zip): the latest release
- [Source](https://github.com/cocodedk/x-look): code, issues, README
